feature.all_rule: concatenate independently G_fit-standardised source blocks in STRING,SEQUENCE,FUNCTION,TEXT order
feature.missing_rule: fit transforms on present G_fit rows; represent every missing source row by the all-zero post-standardisation vector

ridge.fit_target: mean of separately normalised R0 and R1 coefficients on the frozen G_fit XSVD8 basis
ridge.selection: maximum G_select true-query SoftNDCG@10; exact tie chooses smaller alpha

shuffle.rule: G_fit rows receive one fixed no-self permutation; every non-G_fit row receives a balanced deterministic donor from G_fit

sequence.multi_isoform_rule: arithmetic mean of per-protein embeddings assigned to the gene
sequence.name: esm2_t48_15B_UR50D layer 48 mean residue embedding
sequence.protein_mapping: Ensembl GRCh38 release 105 peptide records; direct current symbol then the frozen unique ENSG recovery map
sequence.residue_rule: mean over residues, truncate at 1022 amino acids

text.mapping: exact current NCBI Symbol, otherwise a unique Synonyms-field match; ambiguous aliases are missing
text.name: NCBI Homo_sapiens Gene descriptions encoded by all-MiniLM-L6-v2
text.pooling: attention-mask mean pooling followed by row L2 normalisation
